headline: "Spring Onion" Stock at 4,500 Dong, One Company Wants to Borrow Nearly 700 Billion Dong More
summary: Camimex Group plans to raise nearly 700 billion dong in additional borrowing, more than its entire market capitalization. Its interest expenses in the first six months were 1.75 times pre-tax profit.
why: Heavy borrowing relative to market value and earnings raises financial risk for shareholders and lenders, which matters for investors assessing a company's balance sheet.
